t18_24.tieu_de: New to work and in a good phase: learn as fast as you can now
t18_24.noi_dung: Take on harder tasks within reach and ask a senior for feedback on each; one year of careful work beats three years of sloppy work.

t25_44.tieu_de: Building your career: a good phase for taking on a bigger role
t25_44.noi_dung: Propose one project you lead from start to finish, and record the results in numbers for your next negotiation.

t45_59.tieu_de: Your experience is your edge: a good time to hold your position and mentor others
t45_59.noi_dung: Pick one or two younger people to train, and turn your way of working into a process, so the work runs while you are away.

t60.tieu_de: Familiar work still goes smoothly: do just enough and keep your joy in the craft
t60.noi_dung: Take on advisory or part-time work at your own pace, and choose work you enjoy over work that pays the most.

t18_24.tieu_de: Early working years at a steady pace: try many things to find what suits you
t18_24.noi_dung: Each quarter, try one new skill linked to your current job, and note which tasks make you lose track of time.

t25_44.tieu_de: Work is steady: you move up through skill, not luck
t25_44.noi_dung: Choose one skill that helps you stand out in your team and practise it for 3 months before you think about changing jobs.

t45_59.tieu_de: Work is stable: a good time to rearrange things and lighten the load
t45_59.noi_dung: Drop one draining task that adds little value, and give that time to the work you do best.

t60.tieu_de: Regular work keeps your mind sharp
t60.noi_dung: Keep one activity on a fixed weekly schedule, such as teaching, gardening or helping with a relative's shop, so your days have a rhythm.

t18_24.tieu_de: New to work and hitting bumps: learn the ropes before rushing to change jobs
t18_24.noi_dung: Stay long enough to learn one full cycle of the work, and ask your manager directly what you should fix first.

t25_44.tieu_de: Work calls for a slower pace: secure your footing before any big move
t25_44.noi_dung: Before changing jobs or starting a business, save at least 6 months of expenses and find one person who will give you honest feedback.

t45_59.tieu_de: A high-pressure phase at work: protect what you already have first
t45_59.noi_dung: Learn the new skills your field now needs and keep good relations with younger colleagues; talk big decisions over with your family first.

t60.tieu_de: Keep extra work light and avoid heavy responsibilities
t60.noi_dung: Do not borrow or act as guarantor for a new venture; take on work that suits your health, with someone alongside you.

t18_24.tieu_de: Money comes in easily: build the habit of keeping some from now on
t18_24.noi_dung: Each payday, move a share into a separate savings account first, then spend the rest.

t25_44.tieu_de: Money flows well: a good time to build savings and plan for big assets
t25_44.noi_dung: First build an emergency fund that covers 6 months of expenses; only put the surplus into long-term options you clearly understand.

t45_59.tieu_de: Good money at this age is best set aside for life after work
t45_59.noi_dung: Work out what you will need after retiring and for big family costs, split it into parts, and do not keep it all in one place.

t60.tieu_de: Enough money to live on: put safety ahead of returns
t60.noi_dung: Keep your money where you can withdraw it when needed, write down your asset papers clearly for your family, and say no to offers of high interest.

t18_24.tieu_de: Money in and out evenly: learn to track spending before you learn to invest
t18_24.noi_dung: Record your spending for a full month to see where it goes; cut one small expense that repeats every day.

t25_44.tieu_de: Money is fine but there is little to spare: keep discipline rather than chase opportunities
t25_44.noi_dung: Set a limit on instalment payments, and wait one more week before deciding on any big purchase.

t45_59.tieu_de: Finances are steady: review your fixed costs every year
t45_59.noi_dung: Look again at your insurance, your loans and the money you have lent; trim whatever you no longer need.

t60.tieu_de: Steady spending: keep the habit of spending to a plan
t60.noi_dung: Split your money by month and set aside a separate amount for health check-ups and surprises.

t18_24.tieu_de: Money runs short easily in this phase: do not borrow to keep up with friends
t18_24.noi_dung: Avoid buy-now-pay-later for things you can wait for; if in debt, clear high-interest debt first.

t25_44.tieu_de: Money calls for a slower pace: keep your emergency fund before any plan
t25_44.noi_dung: Do not lend or invest with others without clear paperwork; discuss big moves with the person who shares your expenses.

t45_59.tieu_de: A time to guard money rather than earn more
t45_59.noi_dung: Do not act as guarantor or put all your money in one place; wait a quarter before any new investment.

t60.tieu_de: Money at this age needs careful protection
t60.noi_dung: Be wary of calls and investment offers that promise quick returns; always have a trusted relative look over any large transaction with you.

t18_24.tieu_de: Your energy is good: build healthy routines while it is still easy
t18_24.noi_dung: Keep a regular bedtime and one form of exercise you enjoy; these habits last a long time.

t25_44.tieu_de: Your health is good, but busy years make it easy to neglect
t25_44.noi_dung: Get a general check-up once a year even if you feel well, and keep three exercise sessions a week.

t45_59.tieu_de: Health is good: keep your rhythm, do not overdo it
t45_59.noi_dung: Get the regular check-ups recommended for your age, walk every day, and eat a little less salt.

t60.tieu_de: Your health is good: light exercise every day keeps you strong for longer
t60.noi_dung: Walk, do gentle exercises or garden regularly; keep the check-up schedule your doctor sets.

t18_24.tieu_de: Your health is normal: watch your sleep and screen time
t18_24.noi_dung: Turn off your phone half an hour before bed, drink enough water, and eat breakfast regularly.

t25_44.tieu_de: Your health is holding up: you need a clear rest routine
t25_44.noi_dung: Keep one day a week free of work, sleep a full 7 hours, and get checked if tiredness drags on.

t45_59.tieu_de: Your health needs steady care: small habits matter more than supplements
t45_59.noi_dung: Eat at regular times, get up and move after each hour of sitting, and get check-ups for your age.

t60.tieu_de: Your health needs regular care: rest on time and exercise within your limits
t60.noi_dung: Keep fixed times for meals and sleep, follow your doctor's instructions if you are in treatment, and let a relative know your check-up schedule.

t18_24.tieu_de: Your body is asking you to stay up less and push less
t18_24.noi_dung: Sleep before midnight and do not skip meals to work; if tiredness drags on, get checked early.

t25_44.tieu_de: Work and home are stretching you thin: take rest on purpose
t25_44.noi_dung: Hand some housework and work tasks to others; get a health check-up this quarter, do not wait.

t45_59.tieu_de: A phase to look after your health more actively than in other years
t45_59.noi_dung: Get the regular check-ups for your age, stay up late less, cut the habits that tire you, and do light exercise every day.

t60.tieu_de: Your health needs your family's attention too
t60.noi_dung: Go to check-ups with someone, keep your home bright and walkways clear, and tell your doctor right away if anything feels unusual.

doc_than.tieu_de: Young and in a good phase: easy to meet someone suitable
doc_than.noi_dung: Widen your circle through things you truly enjoy, such as clubs or classes; the right people are often found there.

co_doi.tieu_de: In a relationship during a good phase: grow together
co_doi.noi_dung: Set one small shared goal, like learning something new or saving for a trip, so you have something to do together.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Love in your young years is going well
chua_noi.noi_dung: Spend time with the people you care about, and say what you think honestly and gently.

doc_than.tieu_de: Single and in a good phase for love: a good time to open up seriously
doc_than.noi_dung: Tell close friends you are ready to meet someone new; favour people who share your direction in life.

co_doi.tieu_de: Together and going well: a good time to talk long term
co_doi.noi_dung: Set aside time alone to talk about the next few years (where to live, money, what each of you hopes for) while you are both in good spirits.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Love is going well: a good time to nurture it
chua_noi.noi_dung: Keep a regular weekly date with the person who matters to you.

doc_than.tieu_de: On your own at this age, still a good time to meet someone suitable
doc_than.noi_dung: Go where people share your interests; get to know someone slowly and understand each other before thinking further ahead.

co_doi.tieu_de: Together at this age: a good phase to grow closer
co_doi.noi_dung: Make time again just for the two of you, like a short trip or a new shared hobby.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Love at this age is going well: a good time to say thank you
chua_noi.noi_dung: Tell a loved one one thing you are grateful for in them; a small thing that lasts.

doc_than.tieu_de: Later in life, the timing is still good for a close companion
doc_than.noi_dung: Join groups of people your age, go to services or exercise classes; someone to talk to each day is already good.

co_doi.tieu_de: Someone by your side at this age: a good phase to enjoy life together
co_doi.noi_dung: Keep one small daily habit together, like a morning walk or afternoon tea.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Love at this age is calm: a good time for get-togethers
chua_noi.noi_dung: Call or meet an old friend or relative you have not seen for a long while.

doc_than.tieu_de: Love at a steady pace: no rush, know yourself first
doc_than.noi_dung: Notice which kind of people you are happy around; relationships that start as friendships often last longer.

co_doi.tieu_de: In a relationship at a steady pace: keep asking about each other
co_doi.noi_dung: Each day, ask one real question about the other person's day, and listen fully before giving advice.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Love is normal right now, nothing urgent
chua_noi.noi_dung: Put your energy into study and work; the right person comes when you live at your own pace.

doc_than.tieu_de: Single at a steady pace: meet people on purpose rather than wait
doc_than.noi_dung: Accept one new meeting each month; say early on what you need in a relationship.

co_doi.tieu_de: Together at a steady pace: do not let work crowd each other out
co_doi.noi_dung: Agree on who handles what at home, and keep one phone-free evening a week.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Love is stable and needs care, just like work
chua_noi.noi_dung: Book time for the person who matters to you as you would a meeting, and keep it.

doc_than.tieu_de: On your own at this age: live comfortably first, meet someone later
doc_than.noi_dung: Keep your own life full; the right person comes more easily when you are content with yourself.

co_doi.tieu_de: Together at this age: refresh the way you talk to each other
co_doi.noi_dung: Bring up old issues less and do more new things together; when angry, agree to talk again once you are both calm.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Love at this age is steady: a good time for small gestures
chua_noi.noi_dung: Remember the important days of those close to you; a timely word of care beats a big gift.

doc_than.tieu_de: At this age, having someone to talk to matters more than anything
doc_than.noi_dung: Stay in regular touch with old friends and neighbours, and accept invitations to gatherings with people your age.

co_doi.tieu_de: Two people at a steady pace: give way on small things
co_doi.noi_dung: Share chores by what each can manage, go to check-ups together, and keep each other on regular meals and sleep.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Love at this age is peaceful: keep up regular get-togethers
chua_noi.noi_dung: Set a fixed day each week to meet or call relatives and friends.

doc_than.tieu_de: Young love bruises easily right now: slow down so you do not get hurt
doc_than.noi_dung: Do not rush to believe every promise; keep your own studies, work and friends.

co_doi.tieu_de: In a relationship and quick to argue: learn to talk when you are calm
co_doi.noi_dung: When angry, pause and agree to talk again in a few hours; do not decide big things in the heat of the moment.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Love calls for being gentle with yourself right now
chua_noi.noi_dung: Put your sleep, your studies and trusted friends first; love matters do not need deciding right now.

doc_than.tieu_de: Single at a slower pace: choose carefully rather than quickly
doc_than.noi_dung: Watch how the other person keeps their word and treats the people around them before going further.

co_doi.tieu_de: Together at a slower pace: raise small issues early, before they pile up
co_doi.noi_dung: Each week, spend fifteen minutes calmly talking about the home and money; if needed, ask someone outside for advice.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Love needs active care right now
chua_noi.noi_dung: Promise less and do more; a timely apology keeps a lot intact.

doc_than.tieu_de: On your own at this age: be careful with new acquaintances
doc_than.noi_dung: Get to know people slowly, meet in public places, and do not discuss money or property early on.

co_doi.tieu_de: Together at this age: you need more patience with each other
co_doi.noi_dung: When you disagree, talk about the issue, not the person; find someone you both trust for advice when needed.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Love at this age needs more care than usual
chua_noi.noi_dung: Ask after your loved ones more and blame less; choose a quiet moment for hard conversations.

doc_than.tieu_de: On your own at a slower pace: seek out someone to talk to
doc_than.noi_dung: Join activities in your neighbourhood or community groups; tell your family when you need someone by your side.

co_doi.tieu_de: You two clash easily over small things: give way a little
co_doi.noi_dung: Each keep a hobby of your own, and sit together in the evening to share your day.

chua_noi.tieu_de: At this age, family should look in on you more
chua_noi.noi_dung: Arrange regular calls with your family, and say clearly when you feel sad or tired.

doc_than.tieu_de: Home life is calm: a time to grow closer to family
doc_than.noi_dung: Call or visit your relatives regularly, and share your plans with a trusted family member before you decide.

co_doi.tieu_de: Both families get along: get to know each other gradually
co_doi.noi_dung: Visit your partner's family at a relaxed time, bring a small gift, and listen more than you talk.

chua_noi.tieu_de: The family mood is good
chua_noi.noi_dung: Lend a hand with housework, and keep one meal a week with the whole family.

doc_than.tieu_de: Family life is going well: a good time to help your relatives
doc_than.noi_dung: Agree in advance with your family how to share household tasks, so no one carries them alone.

co_doi.tieu_de: Your shared life is going well: a good time to set routines
co_doi.noi_dung: Agree on a few shared routines (meals together, how you spend money, who does which chores) and keep them up.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Family life is going well: a good time for shared plans
chua_noi.noi_dung: Invite the whole family on a short trip or to a get-together, and share housework evenly.

doc_than.tieu_de: Family life is going well: a good time to bridge the generations
doc_than.noi_dung: Host a family gathering and help younger relatives learn more about your family.

co_doi.tieu_de: Home is going well: both your families need you
co_doi.noi_dung: Schedule visits to the elders on both sides if they are still with you; if you have children, talk with them as adults.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Family life is good: a time to tend it
chua_noi.noi_dung: Note down everyone's important occasions, and help organise a family meal each month.

doc_than.tieu_de: Your family feels close: enjoy the gatherings
doc_than.noi_dung: Tell the younger ones in the family stories from the old days, and teach them a family dish or a family skill.

co_doi.tieu_de: You two and your family are in harmony
co_doi.noi_dung: Keep a fixed day for gatherings, so the whole family can come home at once.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Family life is going well: pass on family ways
chua_noi.noi_dung: Write down recipes, family stories and important papers for your relatives to keep.

doc_than.tieu_de: Home life at a steady pace: become independent while staying in touch
doc_than.noi_dung: Cover part of your own expenses, and call home at least once a week.

co_doi.tieu_de: Your two families are still strangers: take it step by step
co_doi.noi_dung: Let the two families get to know each other naturally, without forcing meetings, and respect the other family's ways.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Family at a steady pace, everyone with their own role
chua_noi.noi_dung: Ask your family what help they need this week, and take on one regular chore of your own.

doc_than.tieu_de: Family at a steady pace: keep boundaries without growing distant
doc_than.noi_dung: Talk gently with your family about your choices; help at home as you can, without promising beyond your means.

co_doi.tieu_de: You two at a steady pace: divide tasks clearly to avoid friction
co_doi.noi_dung: Write down who handles which chores and shared tasks, and review it each month when your schedules change.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Family at a steady pace: give each person a little care
chua_noi.noi_dung: Each week, check in with one family member on their own, beyond the group conversations.

doc_than.tieu_de: Steady home life: care for the elders and for yourself at once
doc_than.noi_dung: Share the care of the elders with your relatives on a schedule, and keep rest time for yourself.

co_doi.tieu_de: You two at a steady pace: agree first, tell others later
co_doi.noi_dung: Agree between yourselves before telling relatives; if you have children, ask their views before decisions that affect them.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Family at a steady pace: keep up the get-togethers
chua_noi.noi_dung: One shared meal each week; whoever is busy calls in at that time.

doc_than.tieu_de: Family at a steady pace: tell your relatives clearly what you want
doc_than.noi_dung: Let your family know how you want to live and what help you need, so everyone can plan more easily.

co_doi.tieu_de: You two at a steady pace: respect each household's privacy
co_doi.noi_dung: Help relatives when asked and give advice when asked; keep your own routines as a couple.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Family at a steady pace: put papers and household matters in order
chua_noi.noi_dung: Keep important papers in one place, and tell one trusted relative where they are.

doc_than.tieu_de: Disagreements come easily at home: reason gently instead of arguing
doc_than.noi_dung: Choose a time when the elders at home are relaxed to say what you want, and hear their reasons in full first.

co_doi.tieu_de: Your two families still have friction: do not force it, give it time
co_doi.noi_dung: Do not make your partner pick sides; be polite and patient with their family.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Home life needs a gentler touch right now
chua_noi.noi_dung: When you disagree, pause and talk again later; ask an older relative the whole family trusts for advice.

doc_than.tieu_de: A lot of pressure at home: share the load, do not carry it alone
doc_than.noi_dung: Sit down with your family to divide housework and money matters clearly, and write it down so no one misunderstands.

co_doi.tieu_de: Shared matters are tense right now: put talking ahead of who is right
co_doi.noi_dung: Each week, set aside time for the two of you to talk calmly about the home and money; if needed, see a counsellor.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Your family needs you to keep the peace actively
chua_noi.noi_dung: Talk less when you are tired, write down household money matters clearly, and raise anything that bothers you early.

doc_than.tieu_de: Family tasks are piling up: rearrange them to match your energy
doc_than.noi_dung: Write down what the elders need and what you need, ask for help where you can, and keep one day off each week.

co_doi.tieu_de: Lots of pressure: you two need to stand on the same side
co_doi.noi_dung: Agree first on money and on the elders on both sides before talking to anyone outside.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Your family needs your patience right now
chua_noi.noi_dung: Talk about property and inheritance early, with paperwork; talk about feelings at a quiet time.

doc_than.tieu_de: Family matters need to be said clearly so your relatives feel at ease
doc_than.noi_dung: Sort out your papers, your assets and your wishes for care if you fall ill, and tell your relatives together.

co_doi.tieu_de: You two need more help from family: just say so
co_doi.noi_dung: Say clearly which tasks you need help with, and give each person a task so no one is overloaded.

chua_noi.tieu_de: Your family needs you to speak first
chua_noi.noi_dung: Call a relative you have not talked to in a long time; close old matters with a gentle word.
